description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableFeature` that implements the `Feature` interface. It models a feature within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including its creation, modification, serialization to JSON, and validation logic. The class manages feature identifiers, optional definitions, and properties, and provides methods for property access and manipulation.

classes.name: ImmutableFeature
classes.description: An immutable representation of a feature within the Ditto framework, encapsulating feature ID, optional definition, and properties, with methods for creation, modification, serialization, and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create new `ImmutableFeature` instances with specified ID, optional definition, and properties, including validation of the feature ID.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new `Feature` with the given definition set, or itself if the same.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns a new `Feature` with the definition removed.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns an `Optional` containing the properties of the feature.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns a new `Feature` with the specified properties.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Returns a new `Feature` with properties removed.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value at a given JSON pointer path.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property at the specified JSON pointer path, returning a new feature.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes the property at the specified JSON pointer path.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an `Optional` containing the feature's definition.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature to a JSON object, considering schema version and filtering predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the feature.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the feature.
